description.value: Thunder Bar is a patio bar located within Thunderbird Show Park, one of North America's premier equestrian event facilities near Langley, BC. The bar operates during show hours alongside a broader lineup of restaurants, food stands, and boutique shops available to spectators at the park's major hunter and jumper tournaments. A touring cyclist visiting on an event day would find this bar embedded in a lively, large-venue atmosphere with world-class show jumping on display.

raw_osm.description: Patio bar open during show hours
raw_osm.name: Thunder Bar

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a bar with the description 'Patio bar open during show hours,' placing it within Thunderbird Show Park, a major equestrian facility in Langley, BC. The website (tbird.ca) confirms this is a large event venue with 'an array of restaurants, bars and boutique shops' at spectator events, and the FAQ mentions multiple on-site dining options; no page specifically names 'Thunder Bar,' but it is consistent with bars described. No bike-specific amenities (parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned for this bar specifically in either the OSM tags or the website content.
concerns: Thunder Bar is explicitly described in OSM as open only during show hours; it is not a standalone, daily-access business, which significantly limits utility for cyclists not coinciding with an equestrian event.
The website (tbird.ca) does not mention 'Thunder Bar' by name; it refers generically to 'bars' at the venue, so the name match relies solely on the OSM record.
URL discovery confidence is rated 'medium'; the website represents the entire Thunderbird Show Park, not the bar specifically.
OSM has no address or phone number; values above are drawn from the website's listed spectator entrance address and main phone number for the broader venue.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operational patio bar within an active equestrian venue; the website confirms ongoing events and the business is publicly accessible to spectators on event days.
enrichment_extras.notes: Cyclists would only find this bar accessible on equestrian event days. The broader Thunderbird Show Park venue does have multiple food and dining options on event days, per the website FAQ.
